study_identification_part.si_4_title: Structural variability of the cerebral cortex in schizophrenia and its association with clinical symptoms

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Person-based similarity index (PBSI) scores were used as the normative metric; deviant vs other patients defined by PBSI z-scores.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text:
We calculated the coefficient of variation (CV) and person-based similarity index (PBSI) scores and performed group comparisons. Associations between the PBSI scores and cognitive functions were evaluated using Spearman ' s rho test and normative modeling.
We used a normative model in which the deviant and other patients were divided using the z scores of the PBSI scores.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical surface area, gray matter volume, cortical thickness, and local gyrification index from T1-weighted MRI.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Four morphometric features across 308 cortical structures were calculated: surface area, gray matter volume, thickness, and local gyrification index.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Joo2024.pdf.md: Image acquisition, preprocessing, and quality control

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, sex, and diagnosis were used as covariates in ComBat harmonization.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We performed ComBat harmonization to adjust for the variation generated from the use of different neuroimaging datasets with the covariates of age, sex, and diagnosis.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: S0033291723001988sup001.docx.md: ComBat harmonization, outlier removal, and the validation of age and sex matching
